issue.title: 429 responses retry without delay
issue.body: The HTTP client ignores Retry-After on 429 and immediately retries.

candidates.title: Retries ignore 503 backoff
candidates.body: 503 responses retry immediately; the client has a different 503 retry implementation.

candidates.title: Honor Retry-After on rate limits
candidates.body: For 429, the HTTP client ignores the Retry-After header and retries at once.
